COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
MCC No. 8211 of 2021
In
AO No. 249 of 2018
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Through Hybrid Mode)
Mr. Naresh Pant, Advocate for the
appellant.
Mr. Sachin Veer Singh, Advocate on
behalf of Mr. Aamir Malik, Advocate for the
respondents.
The Insurance Company has preferred this
Appeal from Order under Section 173 of the
Motor Vehicles Act, questioning the validity of
an award dated 17th March, 2018, which was
rendered by the District Judge, Pithoragarh, in
MACP No. 61 of 2016, Smt. Kalawati Devi and
another Vs. Smt. Manju Devi and others.
As a consequence of filing of the Appeal
from Order, against the said award, initially, the
Appeal was admitted by an order of 21st June,
2018, but, thereafter, it was dismissed for want
of prosecution on 9th August, 2018, and
thereafter, it has not been restored, nor even it
was sought to be restored by filing an
appropriate application.
The appellant has filed an Application No.
8211 of 2021, praying for that an appropriate
direction may be issued to the Registry, to remit

the amount of Rs.25,000/-, which has been
deposited by the appellant, as a condition
precedent, being statutory deposit for the
purposes of institution of Appeal from Order in
the Registry. Because of the fact that the Appeal
has been dismissed for want of prosecution, as
on today, there is no legally sustainable Appeal
pending before this Court. Obviously, the
claimants would be entitled for the amount
deposited to the tune of Rs. 25,000/-, which is a
part of the claim awarded to the respondents/
claimants.
In view of the aforesaid, the Application
for Money Withdrawal is allowed. The Registry
is directed to remit the amount of Rs.25,000/- to
the claimants, within two weeks from the date of
presentation of this order.
